title: Clock and Regiment
author: Theo Amberdale
blurb: Orsen Winterbourne, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
